integration_guardrails: Retain exact grade, model-year, drive and battery keys. Premium N Line is not IONIQ 5 N.
Prices require priceType, currency, geography, options, source and expiry. Never use finance repayment, pre-LCT raw field, expired promotional headline or dealer discount as MLP.
Do not label advertised 84kWh as usable. Do not label 350kW test-station rating or 277kW battery output as vehicle DC maximum.
Cargo figures are VDA and rear versus front must remain separate. Do not call VDA volume SAE volume.
I5 consumption footnote is ADR81/02 while range is WLTP combined; preserve separate cycle labels.
Current MY27 I5 V2L is unverified because dedicated row was dropped from spec; omission alone does not prove removal.
Use spec-sheet power/torque boost distinctions; headline tiles on N pages incorrectly label unboosted 448kW/740Nm as with N Grin Boost.
N price/configuration uncertainties should be visible rather than silently imputed from $115,000 launch coverage.
